pages.text: Blood can be obtained from altering Milk. As a liquid, it acts similarly to Water and is relatively safe to swim through. Although it's highly uncomfortable, it's possible to 'breathe' in it, so there is no danger of drowning. Instead, what makes Blood very dangerous are open wounds as it will enter those and stop the ability to regenerate.

When Blood comes into contact with Water, it will create a Coagulated Blood Block. When the same happens with Lava, it will create Scab and Laughing Obsidian, which can also be altered from Crying Obsidian. Due to how easy it is to gather and harvest, Coagulated Blood can be quite useful as scaffolding.
